findings.highlight: the parchment in his hand
findings.evidenceJa: 手元に敷かれた羊皮紙
findings.governingReading: the parchment spread out before his hands
findings.explanation: The report is changed from a document laid on the work surface to one held in Kirei’s hand.

findings.highlight: The voice comes from behind him without revealing its source
findings.evidenceJa: 声は気配もなく、背後からかけられた
findings.governingReading: the voice addresses him from behind without any accompanying presence
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s supernatural absence of detectable presence becomes uncertainty about where a plainly rearward voice originates.

findings.highlight: moves on to his next task
findings.evidenceJa: 二つ目の仕事に取り掛かる
findings.governingReading: sets about his second task
findings.explanation: The numbered parallel between listening and continuing his work is generalized into sequence.

findings.highlight: Either association is aware of the necessary clean-up measures
findings.evidenceJa: どちらの組織もこの程度の後処理は承知の上だ
findings.governingReading: both organizations understand and accept cleanup on this scale
findings.explanation: Joint institutional preparedness becomes a claim that either one may be aware, while the organization/association homophone layer disappears.

findings.highlight: this town will become barren of life
findings.evidenceJa: この街は無人になるぞ
findings.governingReading: this town will become uninhabited
findings.explanation: A prediction about the human population is expanded to the absence of all life.

findings.highlight: He knows what the man wants to say
findings.evidenceJa: 青年の言い分など、彼とて承知している
findings.governingReading: Kirei too already understands the young man’s argument
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s stated case becomes an unspoken communicative intention.

findings.highlight: exceed the regulated allowances
findings.evidenceJa: 規定量を超える
findings.governingReading: exceed the prescribed or tolerable threshold
findings.explanation: The danger threshold is rendered as though an authority has granted permissible extraction allowances.

findings.highlight: It should not be an amateur, so it should know its limits
findings.evidenceJa: 素人ではあるまいし、際限を知らぬという訳でもあるまい
findings.governingReading: the perpetrator is presumably no amateur and presumably not ignorant of limits
findings.explanation: The paired cautious negatives become an awkward positive assertion about an undefined “it.”

findings.highlight: such a person will become a curse if you do not take care of it quickly
findings.evidenceJa: 早目に潰さねば祟るぞ
findings.governingReading: that sort will bring lasting harm unless crushed early
findings.explanation: A warning about dangerous consequences becomes literal transformation into a curse.

findings.highlight: It is not my style to watch people in this town die
findings.evidenceJa: おめおめと街の人間を殺されるのは性にあわぬ
findings.governingReading: even Gilgamesh is not disposed to stand meekly by while someone kills the townspeople
findings.explanation: His objection includes humiliation at passively allowing another killer to act; the English keeps only personal taste.

findings.highlight: This man, who does not care about anyone else
findings.evidenceJa: 自分以外は何者も要らぬという男
findings.governingReading: a man who says he needs no one but himself
findings.explanation: Radical self-sufficiency and rejection of all others become emotional indifference.

findings.highlight: People will lose their way with boring crime and punishment
findings.evidenceJa: 人が人を屠らばつまらぬ罪罰で迷おう
findings.governingReading: if humans slaughter humans, they become lost in trivial guilt, crime, and punishment
findings.explanation: The English obscures the causal moral suffering Gilgamesh finds unentertaining.

findings.highlight: Exterminating them will be doing them a service
findings.evidenceJa: 一掃するのが正義というものだろう
findings.governingReading: sweeping them all away is what justice demands
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s claim to sovereign justice becomes benevolent service performed for the victims.

findings.highlight: absolute dominance and dignity
findings.evidenceJa: 絶対的な余裕と威厳
findings.governingReading: absolute composure or assured superiority and majesty
findings.explanation: The unshakable ease coloring Gilgamesh’s contempt is replaced with control over others.

findings.highlight: The only thing I have is the desire for clear pleasure
findings.evidenceJa: 明確な快楽を欲する己のみだ
findings.governingReading: all Kirei has is the self that desires a definite pleasure
findings.explanation: Kirei’s statement about his own desiring self is reduced to possession of an abstract desire.

findings.highlight: you have kept me
findings.evidenceJa: 我をここまで繋ぎとめた
findings.governingReading: has kept Gilgamesh tethered here all this time
findings.explanation: The spatial and extended force of the bond explaining their partnership disappears.

findings.highlight: the silent stone room
findings.evidenceJa: 静寂を取り戻した石室
findings.governingReading: the stone chamber after it recovers its silence
findings.explanation: The room’s transition back to silence after Gilgamesh’s presence vanishes is flattened into a static description.

findings.highlight: insane
findings.evidenceJa: 酔っているように見えて
findings.governingReading: although he appears intoxicated
findings.explanation: mirror moon prints “insane” as a competing variant beside the correct intoxication reading, adding a different diagnosis.

findings.highlight: The fact is accepted as truth by all
findings.evidenceJa: 自他ともに認めるもの
findings.governingReading: Gilgamesh and others alike acknowledge it
findings.explanation: A claim acknowledged by both the subject and those around him is inflated into universal acceptance as objective truth.

findings.highlight: Lit by the dim light
findings.evidenceJa: 赤い明かりに照らされた
findings.governingReading: illuminated by red light
findings.explanation: The closing visual color is replaced by brightness level.

findings.highlight: resembles a prophet seeing into the future
findings.evidenceJa: 未来を見据える予言者のよう
findings.governingReading: looks like a prophet gazing toward the future
findings.explanation: The image of forward-looking judgment is strengthened toward actual supernatural sight.
